ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

3. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

4. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

5. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.

6. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

7. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.

8. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
